notes: Text in the share-page shape as a person types it: a sentence on each speaker line, a blank line, more text.

Apple discards the text after 'You said:' and 'Claude responded:' whenever more text follows: the first sentence of both turns is lost. The web app keeps it as the first line of the turn, because the line after it does not begin with it.
